mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (measured as the month-over-month decrease in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market weakness indicated by the unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as it signals economic distress and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% annually), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where INDPRO rises month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 2.0% (as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 yoy growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
